subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should the Groq package raise its declared host/API floor for `maxTokensSource`, or should the recovery retain a safe path for currently declared older hosts?
rationale: The PR adds a runtime dependency on a host model-provenance field while retaining an older compatibility declaration; choosing a permanent external-plugin upgrade contract is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Raise the compatibility floor
options.body: Update the Groq package manifest to require the first host/API version that supplies `maxTokensSource`, with focused package compatibility coverage.

options.title: Support declared older hosts
options.body: Implement a safe older-host discriminator for the built-in discovered default without overriding configured output budgets.

options.title: Pause the fallback approach
options.body: Do not merge the retry until maintainers choose a plugin upgrade policy for this new host contract.

recommendation.title: Raise the compatibility floor
recommendation.body: Update the Groq package manifest to require the first host/API version that supplies `maxTokensSource`, with focused package compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent branch commit addresses the recovery wrapper and is the closest available history signal for the mechanical compatibility repair.
